records.snippet: Brennan's fall cocktails include several options named after New Orleans neighborhoods: THE FRENCH QUARTER ($14.00) with Pear Purée, Orgeat, Aromatic Bitters, and Sparkling Wine; GARDEN DISTRICT ($18.00) with Cognac, Apricot Eau de Vie, Creole Orgeat, Lemon Juice, and Angostura with Egg White; UPTOWN ($15.00) with Rye, Fig, and Dale Degroff Pimento Bitters; THE MARIGNY ($18.00) with Vida Mezcal, Pear Eau de Vie, St. George Spiced Pear Liqueur, Cointreau, and Lemon Juice with Pinot Noir; THE BYWATER ($16.00) with Aperitivo, Cranberry Juice, Apple Shrub, and Lemon Juice; THE 9TH WARD ($15.00) with Vodka, Passionfruit Syrup, Licor 43, Coconut Crème, and Lime Juice; and THE CHANNEL ($14.00) with Irish Whiskey, Drambuie, Ginger, Lime Juice, and Pomegranate.
records.site: places.singleplatform.com (confirmed as the source by a second query)
records.query: Brennan's New Orleans fall cocktail menu 2026 new cocktails Roost bar review ; confirmed by: Brennan's "Garden District" cognac apricot eau de vie "The Marigny" Vida mezcal "The Channel" Drambuie cocktail

gaps: Search count: 19 queries were run against a budget of 18; the 19th (spirit-free neighbourhood names) returned nothing new.
The fall 2026 cocktail list was not found. The live cocktails page still shows Summer Vacations of 1946 in the index; a neighbourhood themed fall list exists on SinglePlatform but is undated.
Eye openers on the current list: no snippet gave a build or price beyond what the guide holds (Bloody Bull $13, Brandy Milk Punch $12, Bloody Mary $11, Irish Coffee $12).
Brennan's Irish Coffee: price ($9 on a dessert page snippet against $12 in the guide) and whiskey (Jameson against Bushmill's) disagree by source; ask the bar.
Cold Shoulder and NOLA-GRONI share one build across two summaries of the past PDF; the true Cold Shoulder build is unknown.
No beer or cider list for Brennan's was found in any snippet; whether the Roost pours beer, and which, is unknown.
No neat spirits list (whiskey, rye, Cognac, Armagnac, rum, absinthe) with pour prices was found; only spirits named inside cocktails are recorded.
Which rum and which liqueurs are used tableside for Bananas Foster and Cherries Jubilee was not found in a snippet.

Spirit-free: only Catalina Island and Black Hills are confirmed on the live page; the neighbourhood named zero-proof list (City Park, Bayou St. John, Uptown, the Marigny) has no builds or prices and an unidentified source.

Bubbles at Brennan's happy hour bottle prices (Mirabelle, Henriot, Taittinger, Piper 'Brennan's Essential', Diebolt-Vallois, Billecart magnum, Charles Heidsieck rosé, Dom Pérignon 2015) were seen in the same snippet but belong to the Champagne lens and are already recorded there in part; not duplicated here.
Revive cold-pressed juice flavours and the Café Glacé build were not found.
Who runs the Roost bar in 2026 is unknown; the Roost page copy still credits Lu Brow.
